newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Trust falls on forecast revision.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Trust falls on forecast revision.

text.p: Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp shares fell in the Monday morning session, depressed by its downward revision of its earnings forecast late last week, brokers said.
As of 0145 GMT, the shares were down 80 yen at 1,170 yen. It was the second largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
On Friday, Mitsubishi Trust said it expected to make a parent current profit for the year to March 31 of 130.00 billion yen, down from a previous estimate of 150.00 billion.

"The shares have fallen to their lowest since July 1995, due to the glum outlook," a trader at a foreign brokerage said. "The fall is further proof that Japan's financial sector is under fierce selling pressure."
